# Load required libraries
library(readxl)
library(DT)

render_datatable <- function(data, digits = 2) {
  numeric_cols <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.numeric)]

# Define a function to render a datatable
#render_datatable <- function(data) {
  datatable(
    data,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 20,
      autoWidth = TRUE
    ),
    rownames = FALSE
  )%>%
    formatRound(columns = numeric_cols, digits = digits)
}

# Output plain text for Anson County
cat("**Anson County**  \n")
cat("**Sq. Mi = 548.35**  \n\n")

# Read data from Anson County sheet
data_anson <- read_excel("C:/MRM/docs/other/xlsx/LandUseStat.xlsx", sheet = "Anson")

# Render the interactive datatable for Cabarrus County
render_datatable(data_anson)
